09/13/2023
Claim opened after the insured reported a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The adjuster confirmed the
policy was active and the reporting driver is named on the policy.
09/14/2023
Photos taken at the scene confirm some details of the impact, including the position of both vehicles after the
collision. No independent witnesses have come forward to the adjuster.
11/03/2023
Vehicle damage to the rear of the insured's car matches the described impact. No earlier damage to the vehicle is
known from prior claims or inspection notes.
12/02/2023
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage. The adjuster has requested the prior policy
history to close this point.
12/11/2023
The claimant, now represented by counsel, gave a recorded statement describing neck pain shortly after the impact.
The account has been consistent with what the claimant told the adjuster in every earlier conversation.
01/06/2024
It is not fully clear from the claimant's description or the photos where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting at the
moment of impact. The adjuster has asked counsel for a setaing diagram.
01/29/2024
Medical records show a diagnosis of whiplash. It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash, and the
treating physician's causation opinion has been requested.
02/09/2024
The records show no earlier injury to the same area of the neck or upper back. The adjuster has noted this for the file.
02/16/2024
Treatment followed a usual course for this type of injury, with physical therapy and medication. Visits tapered off as
the patient improved.
02/27/2024
Counsel submitted a demand package with treatment bills and wage documentation. The adjuster is reviewing the
bills against the records and the timeline of care.
02/29/2024
File remains open pending the causation opinion and review of the demand. The adjuster will reassess reesrves once
those items are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
